content.query:
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL cred_root
WITH
IDENTITY ='Managed Identity'

create EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_silver
WITH
(LOCATION='https://stdatalakeprjt.blob.core.windows.net/silver/',CREDENTIAL=cred_root);


create EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_gold
WITH
(LOCATION='https://stdatalakeprjt.blob.core.windows.net/gold/',CREDENTIAL=cred_root)


CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT file_parquet
WITH (
         FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET
     , DATA_COMPRESSION = 
        'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec')
